in_hebrew.name: בַדגֶר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'dg', meaning to fight or contend. The name Badger could be seen as a reference to the animal's fierce and tenacious nature.

in_greek.name: Βάδγερ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'bados', meaning to fight or to put on armor. The name Badger could be seen as a reference to the animal's strength and courage.

in_latin.name: Badgerius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'badus', meaning little or small, and 'gerere', meaning to bear or to carry. The name Badger could be seen as a reference to the animal's small size and its ability to carry or bear heavy loads.
